// servo_min_us: Per-servo minimum pulse width. Order: S0=Base, S1=Upper, S2=Last, S3=Joint1, S4=Joint2, S5=Gripper.
// servo_max_us: Per-servo maximum pulse width. Same order.
// smooth_velocity: Max us/tick (50 Hz tick) per servo. SG90 mech max ~133 us/tick @ 6666 us/s; we cap at 50%% for gearbox margin. Order: Base, Elbow, Forearm, Wrist1, Wrist2, Gripper.
// smooth_accel: Max us/tick^2 per servo. Sized so v_max is reached in ~5 ticks (100 ms) — snappy without jerk.
// smooth_deadband: Hold-pose deadband in micros. 10 us = 2 PCA9685 LSBs (~4.88 us each). Below this PWM can't move anyway.
// servo_pca_ch: Logical slot (0..5) -> physical PCA9685 channel (0..15). Same order as servo arrays above. Default is identity; override to wire to non-contiguous PCA channels.
// interp_conf_floor_pct: SVM confidence floor for class hold (0-100).
// interp_conf_ceil_pct: SVM confidence ceiling above which class commits (0-100).
// grip_stall_recover_ms: Time before stall watchdog retreats to grip_touch_us.
